approaches.title: Precompute mirror-jump transitions
approaches.summary: For each open cell, recursively follow the effect of a move to find the next reachable cell. Then propagate path counts over the resulting transitions.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds a jump map by recursively resolving mirror effects, then uses grid DP to count paths along those transitions.

approaches.title: Track path counts by arrival direction
approaches.summary: Use dynamic programming states that distinguish paths arriving from the left or from above; a mirror transfers the incoming count to the other direction. Later revisions compress the table and simplify the state storage while preserving this recurrence.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the jump map with a two-state-per-cell DP that propagates counts according to the direction of arrival.
Compresses the two-state DP from a full grid to one row of states.
